problem: Converting bounds with float() rounds ints above 2**53 and Fraction/Decimal bounds, turns very large Decimals into an unbounded end with a closed flag, raises OverflowError/TypeError on inputs main accepted instead of the promised ValueError, and returns every int bound as a float.

The library now needs a top-level reference_impl module when imported; a missing or same-named file in the caller's directory breaks it or replaces its input checks, and any test comparing it with that reference now compares the code with itself.
parse calls another module's private _Algebra.parse with this module's _Algebra as self, which works only because both classes share the helper methods it calls (pyright reports a type error here).
The rework changes parse behaviour without adding any test, and the repo has none, so the regressions in F1 would go uncaught.
